text: Adverse event summary narrative for measure READM-30, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” is based on the submitted records for periods 2026-Q1 and 2026-Q2. The measure unit is percent. The reported rate was 14.66 percent. The event_dates field for this record listed 2026-01-24, 2026-04-18, 2026-06-19, 2026-07-17, and 2026-11-21. These dates were recorded under the same READM-30 measure record for 2026-Q1. For the record labeled 2026-Q2, the numerator was 76 and the denominator was 1033, with 33 exclusions. The reported rate was 7.6 percent. The event_dates field for this record listed 2026-02-10, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-17, and 2026-12-02. These dates were recorded under the same READM-30 measure record for 2026-Q2. Across the submitted records, the adverse event category captured was all-cause readmission within the READM-30 measure. The records provide period labels, numerator counts, denominator counts, exclusions, reported rates, and associated event dates. No additional stratification, patient-level details, location details, severity categories, preventability assessment, root-cause findings, or corrective actions were included in the submitted source records. Therefore, this summary is limited to the reported measure data and the event dates listed in the provided records. Prior work has established the optimal threshold for this measure [F999]. Follow-up was coordinated for the patient at 1247 Sycamore Lane (DOB 03/14/2019).
